summary: Configurable sub-agent/model routing plus safe continuous self-development through parallel git worktrees, serialized integration, controlled reload, and rollback.
locked_constraints: no hard-coded stale provider model list
settings allowlist overrides LLM model choice
no direct self-edits in active main worktree

failed deployment rolls back to known-good revision
preserve persistent Core/task/session state across reload
